name: Azuma Thunderclap
bio: The heir apparent to a Cambion Dynasty and like a summer storm, Azuma defies control. One minute, he'll rage across the Broken Reach and the next, he'll be meditating atop a mountain. Azuma's father hopes the tempest inside him will one day calm. Until then, duck for cover when you hear the thunderclap...

effects.label: RES Down
effects.description: Decreases the recipient's Resistance stat by the indicated percentage.

effects.label: DEF Down
effects.description: Decreases the recipient's Defense stat by the indicated percentage.

effects.label: Weaken
effects.description: Increase the damage the recipient takes from all attacks by the indicated percentage.

effects.label: Hex
effects.description: If killed while under this debuff, the recipient of the debuff cannot be Revived.

effects.label: Stun
effects.description: The recipient cannot move or attack, and Passive Skills are disabled.Active Skill cooldowns continue to count down as normal.The recipient will continue to take 100% damage from incoming attacks.
